subject: QBR prep: account ledger rollcall + ownership matrix requests
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: -
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: account ledger rollcall + ownership matrix requests

Team —

We need a compact, account-by-account ledger for the upcoming QBR (deck due Mon 6/7). Ask from me: please update the attached "qbr_account_ledger_master.xlsx" tab for your owned accounts with the following columns populated by EOD Fri 6/4 PST:
- Account owner (confirm)
- Current ACV / MRR
- Stage (Discovery / Eval / Contract / Legal / Commit)
- Forecast commitment (Best / Likely / Worst) — numeric values
- Confidence (1-5) and short rationale (one line)
- Key blocker(s) and required Redwood action (if any)
- Next milestone & target date
- Suggested leadership ask (approve credit, escalate SLA, assign AE backup)

Two additional asks:
1) For any account > $50k ACV where legal or procurement is involved, paste the most recent procurement thread link in the sheet and attach any redlines (we'll need these for the board appendix).
2) Where you think we should move a deal from "Likely" to "Commit" for this quarter, mark clearly and add a one-line justification. Leadership will review with a bias toward defensible commitments only.

I started a row for Acme Corp as an example. I'm copying the Acme PO directly on the next email so we can confirm dates.

Thanks — aim for concise entries so we can stitch the deck quickly.

— David
David Kim
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: QBR prep: account ledger rollcall + ownership matrix requests

David — thanks, copying my updates below and saved into the sheet (tab: MARISSA_6.3). Quick highlights so leadership can scan: 

Acme Corp (owner: Marissa Cole)
- ACV: $120,000 ARR
- Stage: Contract
- Forecast commit (Best/Likely/Worst): 140k / 120k / 90k
- Confidence: 4 — procurement cycle mostly done, waiting on P.O. approvals from finance (Sarah Liao).
- Blockers: PO approval, two line-item pricing clarifications (see attached redline: acme_mutual_action_plan.pdf).
- Next milestone: Receive PO by 6/9 (target)
- Suggested leadership ask: Approve 10% credit on MSA start date if they ask for a phased rollout (we can set a conditional credit in contract)

BlueOcean (owner: Karthik, I supported initial call)
- ACV: $48,000 ARR
- Stage: Eval
- Forecast commit: 55k / 48k / 25k
- Confidence: 3 — technical eval next week, they flagged throughput concerns; proposed dedicated pilot.
- Blockers: Pilot budget approval; procurement exploratory call pending.
- Next milestone: Pilot kick-off 6/15
- Suggested leadership ask: Approve short-term pilot rebate (up to 25% of pilot cost) if pilot confirms perf.

Notes: I attached an annotated row for Acme and a short summary paragraph per account. I left the "Ownership Matrix" sheet with proposed backups for off-cycle coverage.

Attachments: qbr_account_ledger_master.xlsx (updated tab: MARISSA_6.3), acme_mutual_action_plan.pdf

— Marissa

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifying points from my side: 
1) For BlueOcean, I'll confirm the pilot budget by 6/8; if we don't have budget approval, please mark the commit as "Likely -> Worst" for the deck.
2) I added a proposed "AE backup" for Acme on the ownership matrix (sheet: OWNERSHIP) in case Marissa is on PTO during legal review.
3) Request to leadership: if Acme requests phased billing, let's pre-approve a standard 8-10% start-up credit rather than ad-hoc credits. That will speed sign-offs.

I pushed a small update to the master sheet (tab: KARTHIK_6.3) — primarily stage normalization (Discovery/Eval/Contract/Legal/Commit) so we can pivot the deck filters.

— Karthik

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

All — consolidated and cleaned the ledger; pulled the "Likely" column into the QBR slide template. Changes of note: 
- Acme: moved to Commit in the deck with a caveat footnote (PO expected 6/9). I also added the redline summary under "Legal status" and linked to the DocuSign draft (link in sheet).
- BlueOcean: kept as Eval; pilot is on the QBR risk radar (50% upside if pilot succeeds).
- Net-new asks: leadership review needed on two small credits (Acme conditional credit; BlueOcean pilot rebate).

Sarah — looping you in to confirm PO timing. Sarah, if 6/9 is still the plan, we will show Acme as "Commit" with the noted footnote in the public QBR deck. If it's slipping past 6/10, I will flip to "Likely" before final export.

I attached the final cleaned file (tab: QBR_MASTER_READY).

Thanks everyone — I'll stitch the QBR slides after noon PST Saturday and circulate a draft.

— Tessa
